facilities.name: Lägerplats Äskhult
facilities.description: Shelter with room for about 4-5 people and a fireplace. Toilet and drinking water are at the Äskhults by parking area and are seasonal/conditional. Äskhult reserve rules restrict or prohibit fire depending on exact reserve/designated-place boundary; do not publish broad fire-use copy until verified. This record duplicates the N2 endpoint cluster and should be normalized once for Äskhult.

facilities.name: Toalett Äskhults by
facilities.description: WC by the Äskhults by parking area. The place text says water filling is possible when the water is on and that the toilet is closed in winter. Official category says open year-round, but the description says winter closure. Treat as seasonal/conditional until verified.

facilities.name: Äskhults by
facilities.description: Cultural reserve and 1700s village environment. Seasonal cafe/building access; outdoor trails and area access are broader than building opening hours. Cafe and building visits are seasonal; do not imply year-round food service.

facilities.name: Riksdagsmannagården i Axtorp
facilities.description: Historic farm in Axtorp associated with Aron Christoffer Gunnarsson.

facilities.name: Jättegrytan i Axtorp
facilities.description: Glacial pothole from the Ice Age, with a small informal picnic spot described by Hallandsleden. Picnic furniture details are from Hallandsleden text and were not independently verified.

facilities.name: Hålväg vid Rammbäcken
facilities.description: Old hollow-road feature formed by historic movement of people and animals through loose ground. Slightly off the GPX line; verify side-path visibility/signage if precise on-route classification matters.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Stättared
facilities.description: Stage campsite by Stora Hornsjön with shelter for 4-5 adults, two fireplaces, toilet, bathing place, rest area and fishing context. Drinking water is at Stättareds 4H-gård, not at the shelter. Model water separately at Stättareds 4H-gård. Fire use still depends on current fire-ban/fire-risk status.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten Stättareds gård
facilities.description: Water bottle filling at Stättareds gård, a side trip from the trail. Need confirmation whether the tap is available when farm buildings/cafe are unmanned.

facilities.name: Stättareds 4H-gård & vandrarhem
facilities.description: 4H farm, hostel, activity site and seasonal/weekend cafe. The farm area is open year-round for visits; the cafe has limited/seasonal hours. Hostel has 21 beds, kitchen and breakfast basket option, but no other meals. Side path from Hallandsleden; not directly at the GPX endpoint. Do not imply full meal service from the hostel.
